properties.title: only guard can call mint
properties.statement: For every caller that is not `guard()`, and for all arguments (and any ETH sent), `mint` reverts.
properties.rationale: mint (line 36) reverts on a comparison of msg.sender with guard.
properties.scope: all callers outside the set, all arguments, from the setup state

properties.title: only guard can call burn
properties.statement: For every caller that is not `guard()`, and for all arguments (and any ETH sent), `burn` reverts.
properties.rationale: burn (line 37) reverts on a comparison of msg.sender with guard.
properties.scope: all callers outside the set, all arguments, from the setup state

properties.title: totalSupply moves exactly with the balanceOf it sums
properties.statement: Every call changes `totalSupply` by exactly the total change of `balanceOf` over the accounts it touches (the caller and every address argument): nothing is created or lost in between. Transfers leave `totalSupply` unchanged.
properties.rationale: balanceOf and totalSupply are written together in mint, burn.
properties.scope: every function that writes either, any caller and arguments, from any state reachable in prover.depth-1 steps
